name: TRMNL client
description: HTTP-polled e-paper client compatible with the TRMNL BYOS protocol. Devices (jailbroken Kindles running the KOReader trmnl-display plugin, TRMNL devices, anything that speaks the protocol) poll GET /api/display on a fixed cadence and paint the latest frame. Identity is the access_token the user generates in Tesserae and pastes into the client config, no MAC, no MQTT, no pairing flow.

refresh_rate_s.label: Refresh rate
refresh_rate_s.help: How often the client polls /api/display for a new frame. The server echoes this back in the response so the client honours it (though some clients keep their own poll rate).
